$comment: Model map for the outdoor shop model, started from ../model-map.json with --reuse-map; the agent filled the rest.

measures.목표매출: VAR lastDay = [Last Order Date] RETURN IF ( ISFILTERED ( Products[Product] ) || ISFILTERED ( Products[Subcategory] ) || ISCROSSFILTERED ( Stores ), BLANK (), CALCULATE ( [Budget Sales], TREATAS ( VALUES ( Products[Category] ), Budget[Category] ), KEEPFILTERS ( Calendar[Date] <= lastDay ) ) )

이익 증감률.expr: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [이익] ), DIVIDE ( [이익] - [전년 이익], [전년 이익] ) )

전년 대비 증감률.expr: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [매출] ), DIVIDE ( [매출] - [전년 매출], [전년 매출] ) )

measures.전년 매출: VAR lastDay = [Last Order Date] RETURN CALCULATE ( [Revenue], CALCULATETABLE ( SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( Calendar[Date] ), KEEPFILTERS ( Calendar[Date] <= lastDay ) ) )
measures.전년 이익: VAR lastDay = [Last Order Date] RETURN CALCULATE ( [Gross Profit], CALCULATETABLE ( SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( Calendar[Date] ), KEEPFILTERS ( Calendar[Date] <= lastDay ) ) )

평균할인율.expr: 1 - DIVIDE ( [Revenue], SUMX ( Orders, Orders[Quantity] * Orders[Unit Price] ) )

measures.Orders PY: VAR lastDay = [Last Order Date] RETURN CALCULATE ( [Order Count], CALCULATETABLE ( SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( Calendar[Date] ), KEEPFILTERS ( Calendar[Date] <= lastDay ) ) )
